entries.en: J'yhuh Tia warmly welcomes you back from the Crucible. As your trials have only just begun, he suggests you all return to the Bannock, where you can speak freely.
entries.fr: Votre maître vous a félicité<if(gnum4,e,)> pour votre premier succès au sein du Dédale. Il vous a toutefois demandé de le rejoindre au Bannock afin de lui exposer tous les détails de votre périple.

entries.en: The Crucible of the Unbroken is not simply a gauntlet of battles, but a test of wisdom and tactical skill. To this end, Loosefrox offers an unlikely personal lesson. She strides off, leaving you to follow your prickly comrade and partake of what knowledge she is willing to impart.
entries.fr: Vous avez raconté à J'yhuh Tia et Loosefrox comment s'est déroulée votre traversée du premier plateau. Peu après, la Gobeline a souhaité s'entretenir avec vous afin de vous donner des in<->for<->ma<->tions utiles à la suite des épreuves. Retrouvez-la et partez en vadrouille ensemble.
entries.ja: 闘獣練の対策を練るため、ルースフロクスからアドバイスを受けることになった。バノック練兵所付近の「ルースフロクス」と話そう。

entries.en:
Alone at last, Loosefrox is apologetic for her brash attitude. People are not as easy as beasts to commune with, but she is willing to try. With any luck, a stroll about the Central Shroud will deepen your connection with Loosefrox─and perhaps yield some “beastfacts” along the way.

※You must be accompanied by Loosefrox to complete this task. Speak with her again should you become separated.

entries.en: Loosefrox explains that learning how to exploit the weaknesses of foes you face within the Crucible will be crucial, given its various restrictions. You continue your stroll together, hopeful she has a few more kernels of knowledge to share.
entries.fr: Loosefrox vous a présenté les bases concernant les faiblesses de certaines bêtes. Continuez de vous promener avec elle.
entries.ja: ルースフロクスから、魔獣の弱点についてアドバイスをもらった。中央森林のガビノー親方の小屋付近にある指定地点で、同行中の「ルースフロクス」と再度話そう。

entries.en: The corporeal body, Loosefrox continues, may also be subjected to a variety of ailments. She makes example of her own favorite familiar, claiming the giant sandworm is strongly averse to shockwaves─a fact she demands you immediately forget. You continue your stroll together...
entries.fr: Votre cours champêtre en compagnie de la Gobeline se poursuit, et vous avez appris à profiter des effets de certaines attaques afin d'exploiter les vulnérabilités des bêtes. Continuez d'avancer avec Loosefrox.
entries.ja: ルースフロクスから、状態異常についてアドバイスをもらった。中央森林の裸岩の丘入口付近にある指定地点で、同行中の「ルースフロクス」とさらに話そう。

entries.en: Loosefrox calls for a break, claiming to have lost much of her stamina since her former days as an adventurer. You learn that your goblin compatriot is skilled in wielding all sorts of weapons, but finds her greatest joy in studying beasts of the wild. During the course of her explorations, she once wandered into a nest of sandworms and was saved from certain death by none other than J'yhuh Tia himself. Moved by the connection he shared with his familiars, Loosefrox begged his tutelage and has been a beastmaster ever since. Growing sentimental one moment, she becomes gruff in the next, emphasizing her superior abilities. In fact, she says, she can prove her claim right now by pitting you against one of her familiars. A drake skilled in fire magicks─but you know all you need to win.
entries.fr: La marche a suf<->fi<->sam<->ment épuisé Loosefrox, qui a réclamé une petite pause. Elle vous a partagé une anecdote de son passé<nbsp>: sa rencontre avec J'yhuh Tia et ce qui l'a motivée à devenir dresseuse. En tant que mentor, elle souhaite prouver qu'il reste encore un fossé entre elle et vous, et vous demande de vaincre Moutardonne, une draconide de son bestiaire.

entries.en: Just as Loosefrox is begrudgingly admitting her approval, Lauda emerges from the woods. Instinctively, Loosefrox rises to your defense, but Lauda simply wishes to speak. The Kornago tradition has intrigued her, still captive to Guttler's will though she is. She had never considered beasts to be more than emotionless fiends, but she now reflects upon all she has experienced and seen. She wonders if her people, the Lhu, had been mistaken in their practices, but quickly remembers the part she plays in this charade and disappears once more.
entries.fr: Alors que vous discutiez avec Loosefrox, Lauda est venue vous interrompre. Intriguée par les paroles de J'yhuh Tia, la dresseuse de Lhu souhaite en apprendre davantage sur les méthodes de l'école du cornago. Vos réponses l'ont laissée perplexe et elle vous a quitté<if(gnum4,es,s)> aussitôt. Retournez désormais voir votre maître.

解放できるかもしれないからな。

entries.en: In so doing, even the maiden's captured heart may find peace─and Guttler's soul find rest.
